name: @fx-studio-ai/pipeline-orchestrator
description: v7.9.2 (2026-06-02, PATCH - documentation refresh): brings all user-facing and reference docs up to date with features through v7.9.1 — full Paperclip layer documented (integration v7.6.0 + provisioner v7.8.0 + flow-mirror v7.9.0 with 8 paperclip-* commands + new references/paperclip/PAPERCLIP-FLOW-MIRROR.md), audit-trail run-log section aligned to the v7.9.1 model, gate decision vocabulary aligned to the 8 canonical values, count drift fixed (35-gate registry / 23-row mandatory table / 61 tests), and the MIT->PolyForm license fix in the diagrams. Docs-only; Iron Law preserved. v7.9.0 (2026-06-01, MINOR - Paperclip flow-mirror): mirrors the 14 pipeline flows as dependency-linked Paperclip issue trees + 8 paperclip-* slash commands with dry-run/--confirm guard. v7.8.0 (2026-05-26, MINOR - Paperclip company provisioner): ships references/paperclip/scripts/provision-pipeline-company.cjs, an ID-agnostic Node provisioner that stands up a Paperclip company with the full 47-cargo roster + 11 skills (heartbeat OFF), resolving company by name and computing paths from __dirname (no hardcoded UUIDs). Wired into /pipeline-orchestrator:setup-paperclip. v7.7.0 (2026-05-25, MINOR - OpenCode adaptation marketplace release): ships the OpenCode adaptation harness, commands, agents, skills, contract tests, and hardened physical-evidence gates for bugfix, feature, audit, UX, SPEC, final validation, and closeout. Global OpenCode commands now include audit/UX/SPEC light and heavy flows. End-to-end execution governance for Claude Code. Multi-agent pipeline with TDD, adversarial review, 35-gate registry (23 mandatory), glass-box TRACE.md audit trail. v7.6.1 (2026-05-24): release hygiene PATCH — closes doc drift detected during v7.6.0 npm publish (CLAUDE.md canonical line + cursor manifest description + F7 version-sync test). Zero runtime changes. Suite 58/59 GREEN. v7.6.0 (2026-05-22): Paperclip integration layer — references/paperclip/ ships 14 docs + 11 custom skills enabling the plugin to run inside Paperclip (paperclip.ing open-source agent orchestration) via claude_local adapter with effective parity to Claude Code standalone. Includes PAPERCLIP-AXIOMS.md, 6 workflow specs, KB, catalog, adaptation spec, zoning rule, migration plan with adversarial loop, end-to-end pilot report (PARITY_VERDICT=PASS_WITH_NOTES), install-junctions.bat, /setup-paperclip slash command, and docs/PAPERCLIP-INTEGRATION.md. Zero changes to existing agents/skills/references/commands/lib (paperclip/ is additive subdir). v7.5.0 (2026-05-22): concurrent-safe tracing — RunDirectory.allocate uses exclusive mkdir + collision-resistant uniqueId, runId published on PIPELINE_RUN_ID env-var; Langfuse trace/span carriers + sentinel/stop state discovery keyed on PIPELINE_RUN_ID with graceful PPID/mtime fallback + AUDIT breadcrumbs; PIPELINE_TRACING_SCOPE controls Langfuse observation scope (agent-only default = v7.4.0 parity / agent-plus-skill / full). 5 new regression tests (F1-F5). v7.2.0 (2026-05-21): Phase 0 hardening — STATE_FILE_INIT_FAIL gate (CIRCUIT_BREAKER hard precondition on initial sentinel-state.json write), PROTOCOL_HANDSHAKE_TIMEOUT gate (HARD out-of-band timer via SessionStart hook, default 30min configurable), cleanup-orphan-sentinel-state hook (auto-archive of pipeline_active=true state files older than 24h, closes Achado B1-001), --strict-spec flag (rejects Signal 3/4 Spec detection in unattended/CI mode), STRICT_SPEC_REJECTION gate (AUDIT). 4 patches with ATDD/BDD/DDD per batch and adversarial review per batch (22 findings addressed across all batches). v7.1.1 (2026-05-21): docs-only patch. v7.1.0 (2026-05-19): telemetry hygiene.
